# Antarctic Review Hub

An independent, scored comparison of ten Antarctic expedition cruise operators: shore time per passenger, traveller ratings, price and inclusions, and expedition depth. The scoring formula, worked examples, and what is measured versus editorial judgement are published at /methodology/.
